slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that rural primary clinics (HC II/III) keep paper registers and HMIS tools and that the aggregate data is transcribed from those paper forms into DHIS2 at district level; the review gives no date for this, so its publication date is used, and its country rows are an AI-assisted compilation.

Data Landscapers' review states that EMRs such as UgandaEMR are available in Health Centre IVs and above but are mostly HIV programme-specific, with hybrid paper-digital records in 94%+ of HC IVs and purely digital records in 1-2%, while HC II/III clinics record patients on paper at the point of care; undated in the review, so its publication date is used, and the row is an AI-assisted compilation.

systems.tiers: entered at district level from HC II/III paper forms
HC IV and above; mostly programme-specific (HIV)
pilots in select rural hospitals, not scaled nationally

note: Passages file; one Uganda clinic row. The source is expert analysis compiled with AI assistance and cites PMC12816509, PMC12512544 and an MIT paper as its primaries. It also states a national digital health strategy aiming at point-of-care digital by 2025/26, with no system named.
